name: Catch Silent n8n Failures with NoCrash: Missed Runs and Green-but-Empty Alerts

parameters.content:
This is a basic reliability check you maintain yourself: one config list, one fixed grace window, and a check that only runs when this workflow runs. It catches the two most common silent failures (the run that never fired and the green run that did nothing) for the workflows you remember to list.

NoCrash does this from outside your instance with no build: it learns each workflow’s normal cadence instead of a fixed window, survives your instance going down, and watches n8n alongside your vibecoded apps, URLs, and Stripe. Score a workflow free, no signup: the NoCrash Workflow Grader.

https://nocrash.io/tools/n8n-workflow-grader?utm_source=n8n-templates&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=node-launch-2026

Edit the list in "Which workflows to watch" to match your own n8n. Each row has three parts:
- name: the exact workflow name as it appears in n8n
- expectedEveryMinutes: how often it should run (1440 = daily, 60 = hourly, 15 = every 15 min)
- minItems: the smallest number of items a real run should move (leave at 1)

Prefer Telegram or email? Delete the Slack node and drop a Telegram or Send Email node in its place, then wire it to the "true" branch. The same message text ({{ $json.message }}) works in any of them.
